C:\mingw64\bin\cmake.exe -E rm -f CMakeFiles\ccraft.dir/objects.a
C:\mingw64\bin\llvm-ar.exe qc CMakeFiles\ccraft.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles\ccraft.dir\objects1.rsp
C:\mingw64\bin\clang++.exe -g -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles\ccraft.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o ccraft.exe -Wl,--out-implib,libccraft.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles\ccraft.dir\linkLibs.rsp
